carousels.caption: Gmail’s filter cuts off your subject line after 12 words—everything else is invisible. Here’s how to optimize the first half for inbox placement, not spam. #emailmarketingtips #emaildeliverability #marketingaudit #irishbusiness
carousels.hook: Gmail cuts off your subject line after 12 words—everything else is invisible
carousels.throughline: Gmail’s filter prioritizes the first 12 words of your subject line—here’s how to optimize them for inbox placement.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail cuts you off after 12 words
reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your email team

body_slides.text: Gmail’s filter reads left to right—stop at 12 words or risk truncation.
The first 3 words carry the most weight—lead with your strongest hook.
Avoid spam triggers like ‘free,’ ‘discount,’ or ‘urgent’ in the first half.
Personalization in the first 12 words boosts open rates by 22%.
Test subject lines with Gmail’s preview tool to see how they truncate.
Emails with shorter subjects land in Primary 20% more often than long ones.

carousels.caption: Google Ads bills you for 3-second bounces—even if they leave immediately. Here’s how to stop wasting budget on quick exits. #googleadstips #ppcmanagement #marketingaudit #smallbusinessireland
carousels.hook: Google Ads bills you for 3-second bounces—even if they leave immediately
carousels.throughline: Google Ads charges for 3-second bounces—here’s how to stop wasting budget on quick exits.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads burns budget on 3-second bounces
reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your ads manager

body_slides.text: Google counts a ‘click’ after 3 seconds—even if the visitor bounces.
Enable ‘Engaged-view conversions’ to track only meaningful visits.
Set a minimum time-on-page threshold to exclude bounces.
Exclude mobile users with high bounce rates from targeting.
Use ‘Smart Bidding’ with a focus on conversions, not clicks.
Accounts with this setting save up to 15% on wasted spend.

carousels.hook: Google Ads buries 25% of your best clicks in a report you’ve never opened
carousels.throughline: Google Ads hides your best-performing clicks in a report most advertisers never check—here’s how to find them.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads buries 25% of your best clicks
reel_beats.stat_label: % of clicks hidden in plain sight
reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your PPC team

body_slides.text: Open the ‘Search terms’ report to see what people actually typed.
Sort by conversions to find the searches that turn into sales.
Add high-performing terms as exact match keywords to lock in results.
Exclude irrelevant searches to stop wasting budget on dead ends.
Check this report weekly—new trends appear fast.
Accounts that do this see 25% more conversions for the same budget.

carousels.caption: Gmail’s filter favors emails that spark replies—opens don’t matter as much. Here’s how to shift your strategy for better inbox placement. #emailmarketingtips #emaildeliverability #conversiontracking #smallbusinessireland
carousels.hook: Gmail’s filter favors emails that spark replies—opens don’t matter as much
carousels.throughline: Gmail prioritizes emails that get replies, not just opens—here’s how to shift your strategy.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail buries emails with no replies
reel_beats.stat_label: x more Primary placement with replies
reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your email writer

body_slides.text: Before: Emails with 50% open rates still land in Promotions.
After: Emails with 10 replies get 3x more inbox placement.
Ask a question in your subject line to encourage replies.
Use ‘Reply to’ addresses that go to a real person, not ‘noreply.’
Follow up with a short, personal email to spark conversation.
Lists with reply rates above 5% see 40% higher deliverability.

carousels.caption: Meta Ads freeze after 50 conversions—your campaigns stop getting smarter. Here’s how to restart the learning phase and cut costs. #metaadstips #paidsocial #leadgeneration #irishbusiness
carousels.hook: Meta Ads freeze after 50 conversions—your campaigns stop getting smarter
carousels.throughline: Meta Ads stop learning after 50 conversions—here’s how to keep your campaigns improving.

reel_beats.stat_label: % lower cost per lead with these steps
reel_beats.send_line: Send this to your ads team

body_slides.text: Check your ‘Learning Phase’ status—it resets after 50 conversions.
Increase your budget by 20% to push past the 50-conversion limit.
Refresh your audience every 7 days to avoid fatigue.
Use ‘Advantage+’ audiences to expand reach without losing relevance.
Pause underperforming ads to focus spend on what’s working.
Accounts that follow this see 30% lower cost per lead.
